hlg_0863246461b51d6d_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Assign an available ambulance to an emergency call within 11 minutes of call receipt, ensuring timely response and resource allocation.
hlg_0863246461b51d6d_001.rationale: llg_001 specifies the core capability of assigning an available ambulance to an emergency call within 11 minutes of call receipt. This goal captures the exact functional requirement without generalization or omission, as no other LLGs are provided. The reconstructed goal preserves the strict time constraint and the specific actor (Dispatcher) and object (ambulance) without adding inferred or generalized functionality.

hlg_6ba20cb10b0d20a0_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Log the complete operational timeline and geographic trace of each assigned ambulance from departure to arrival at the scene.
hlg_6ba20cb10b0d20a0_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record the departure time and location (GPS coordinates) of the ambulance, establishing the start point of its operational timeline. llg_002 adds the capability to record the destination address and arrival time, establishing the endpoint of the operational timeline. Together, they define a complete geographic and temporal trace of the ambulance’s movement, with no implicit or inferred operations beyond these two distinct logging actions.

hlg_be971399c23d5fec_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Maintain real-time, continuous GPS-based tracking of ambulance location during active response missions, with mandatory periodic updates every 30 seconds from the driver.
hlg_be971399c23d5fec_001.rationale: llg_001 specifies that the Ambulance Driver must send GPS coordinates every 30 seconds while en route, which directly defines the requirement for real-time, periodic location updates. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal must fully capture this singular capability without inference or generalization.

hlg_ee25dcd232ec6e9b_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable an Emergency Caller to initiate emergency response by dialing a phone number and simultaneously submitting incident details to a dispatch system for coordinated action.
hlg_ee25dcd232ec6e9b_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Emergency Caller to initiate emergency call via phone interface, which triggers logging of incident details; llg_002 enables the Emergency Caller to submit incident details (location, nature of emergency, contact info) to the dispatch system. Together, they form a dual-action capability: initiating a call while simultaneously submitting structured data to a dispatch system — no other capability is implied or inferred.
